one_liner_zh: 羅克威爾自動化最新季度營收與每股盈餘雙雙優於市場預期，顯示工業自動化需求溫和回穩。
one_liner_en: Rockwell Automation reported quarterly revenue and EPS that both beat consensus estimates, indicating a modest recovery in industrial automation demand.
beat_or_miss: 超預期，EPS 3.49美元高於預期的3.38美元，營收達23.1億美元。
highlights_zh: 每股盈餘達 3.49 美元，優於市場預期的 3.38 美元
營收達到 2.31 億美元，年增率為 7.88%
核心工業自動化與數位轉型業務展現韌性
highlights_en: EPS came in at $3.49, beating the estimated $3.38
Revenue reached $2.31B, representing a 7.88% YoY growth
Core industrial automation and digital transformation segments showed resilience
risks_zh: 總體經濟環境不確定性可能影響終端客戶資本支出意願
高本益比（40.25倍）面臨估值拉回壓力
risks_en: Macroeconomic uncertainties could impact end-customers capital expenditure willingness
High trailing P/E ratio of 40.25 exposes the stock to valuation pullback risks
ai_view_zh: 觀點：本季財報優於預期釋出產業落底回溫訊號，對中短期股價具備正向支撐；後續應持續追蹤訂單出貨比（B/C ratio）以及管理層對全年指引的調整。
ai_view_en: View: The earnings beat signals a bottoming and recovery in the industrial sector, providing positive support for near-to-mid-term stock performance. Key metrics to track include the book-to-bill ratio and management adjustments to full-year guidance.
